senses.gloss:
यु r. 2nd cl. (यौति)
 1. To mix, to join, to blend.
 2. To separate or not
mix. r. 10th cl. (यावयते) To censure, to blame, to disrespect, to
despise. (ञ) युञ् r. 9th cl. (युनाति युनीते) To bind, to tie.

यू f. (-यूः) The water in which pulse, &c. has been boiled, pease-soup,
&c.
 E. यु to mix, aff. क्किप्, and vowel made long.
